During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''invaded''' the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Niran]].

==History==
Less than a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] after the invasion, [[Viran Qol]], who had just graduated from a civil [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] program, joined the [[Niran Resistance]].<ref name="Imperial Garrisons" />

Eventually, the Niran Resistance was absorbed into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Qol became an [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance SpecForce]] [[Major/Legends|major]] and one of [[Alliance High Command/Legends|High Command's]] leading experts on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress/Legends|fortifications]].<ref name="Imperial Garrisons" />
